findings.message: property package 'Peng-Robinson (PR)' is a substitution for Peng-Robinson with modified Huron-Vidal mixing rules (loses: the modified Huron-Vidal (excess Gibbs energy) mixing rules; classical one-fluid mixing with kij); accepted: The selection recommends PSRK or Peng-Robinson/RKS with Huron-Vidal or Wong-Sandler mixing rules, none of which the DWSIM route runs; core's contract names Peng-Robinson as their substitute (loses the polar mixing rule). At the separator's own pressure (45 kPa(a)) the tree recommends UNIFAC-LL, which the DWSIM route does not run at all. Peng-Robinson is used as a recorded substitution for an unqualified cross-check only (D-012): the water/aromatics split is not taken from it but specified at the decanter X-101 from aqueous solubilities (D-008). Not approved by an engineer; the run is not evidence for the property model.
